page.layout: One printed page, with no legible text. Only show-through from the reverse side is visible, mostly as faint mirrored lines across the page and an inverted block at the top.
page.notes: The scan shows no printed text of this page that can be read. The faint lines and the inverted block at the top are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. Blue ink dots and spots are stains, not text. The dark band along the right edge is the binding or the edge of the neighbouring page.
